sharingGuestRules.description: Read access to work items flagged public, for the neoGeoTest site guest user. guestUser is the guest's CommunityNickname, not a site developer name - both sites share one guest user, so this value cannot be scoped to one site. Criteria cannot reference Project__r.Is_Public__c, so PublicBoardController's WHERE clause is the only place the parent project flag is enforced.
sharingGuestRules.label: Public Work Items To Site Guest
